assignment_rule: NFC-normalize the 10 exact HUMAN NEWSPAPER author values, sort ascending by UTF-8 bytes, assign consecutive pairs to folds 0..4; AI inherits its matched HUMAN author and fold via pair_id
test_population: all HUMAN and AI rows for the two held-out NEWSPAPER authors
training_population: all ABSTRACT pairs plus all NEWSPAPER pairs from the other eight authors

training.persistent_checkpoint_policy: none; matches authoritative primary run_fit save_strategy=no; predictions and hash-bound run sidecars are resumability authority

statistics.seed_level: pooled held-out predictions across five author folds
statistics.method_level: mean and sample SD across the three seed-level ROC-AUC values

m4_diagnostic.label: diagnostic corpus-separability baseline
m4_diagnostic.features: word(1,2) + char_wb(2,5) TF-IDF, min_df=2, sublinear_tf, L2 Logistic Regression
m4_diagnostic.leakage_rule: TF-IDF fit only on the current training population; test is transform-only

interpretation_if_high: The same author appearing in training and test does not appear necessary for high discrimination; temporal, prompt/generation-procedure, and other corpus-construction confounding remain.
interpretation_if_drop: Source/author dependence will be reported as a contributing factor to internal discrimination and the scope of the primary pair-disjoint interpretation will be narrowed.
